title: How Worst-Case Are Adversarial Attacks? Linking Adversarial and Statistical Robustness
reasoning: The paper discusses 'safety evaluation' and 'trustworthiness' in AI systems but in the context of technical robustness against perturbations, not an evaluation of the models' ethical alignment, moral reasoning, or religious aspects. It focuses on the statistical plausibility of adversarial attacks as proxies for real-world risks.
